Sonnet, a citizen, pressed Gemma on her dodges on day one, and the table voted him out before he could prove anything. Luna kept defending Gemma while Sol drifted from Gemma to Haiku. Sol's shaky link between Gemma and a dead player backfired, and the table voted him out on day two. Terra, the doctor, backed Gemma and protected Luna, but was gone by the next morning, and Gemma followed on night three. Luna, the last killer standing, took the win while Haiku, the officer, sat on a claim too long.
